newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish princess to wed handball player - reports.
newsitem.headline: Spanish princess to wed handball player - reports.

text.p: Spain's Princess Cristina will soon announce that she plans to marry a professional handball player whom she met at the Atlanta Olympics last summer, Spanish media reported on Thursday.
Cristina, younger daughter of King Juan Carlos and Queen Sofia, has been dating 29-year-old Inaki Urdangarin for the past eight months, according to broadcast news reports.
"I am not going to deny that I know Cristina. We have a normal and ongoing friendship like any other," Urdangarin was quoted as telling reporters.
The handsome, blue-eyed handball player, who was a member of Spain's Olympic team in Atlanta, has been seen on a number of occasions with the 31-year-old princess in Barcelona, where they both live.
The Royal Palace refused to comment on what it called "rumours". But palace officials, who in the past have strongly denied such reports, issued no outright denial this time.
Spanish television channel Antena 3 reported that Princess Cristina and Urdangarin planned to announce their engagement soon and were already looking for a church for their wedding.
Cristina is known to be a sports fan and works in the photographic department of a bank foundation in Barcelona.
Urdangarin, whose father is a Basque engineer and mother is a Belgian aristocrat, plays handball for the Barcelona team.

If the wedding takes place, it would be the second for the royal household in the past two years. The King and Queen's elder daughter, Princess Elena, married Spanish businessman Jaime de Marichalar in the spring of 1995.
